newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends higher in rumor-driven trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends higher in rumor-driven trade.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 2.8 higher at 1,015.20 in trading that saw the local currency gain on the back of rumors that the state oil company, Ecopetrol, was preparing to unload a large amount of petrodollars.
Interbank dealers said the rumors, which were subsequently denied, prompted a wave of dollar-selling early in the session that lent solid support to the peso.
Dealers reported an active 398 trades for a total of $156 million and said the peso held in a 1,013.40 to 1,017.50 range.
